A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt=\"A\" src=\"S\"/>\n</div>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
